policy: Decision record only. Nothing here deletes or moves anything; ARCHIVE marks a path retained for provenance rather than routine use, and no evidence is deleted without a separate review.

review_methods.static-review: The comparison was read from the cited files by the reviewing agent. It is neither mechanically enforced nor attributed to a human reviewer; only the path and link properties of a paired runbook are checked by a validator.

coverage_note: Coverage is by top-level repository area plus the specific paths listed below. Additions or renames beneath a broad entry such as docs/ are governed by the existing content gates and are not individually re-audited here, so this inventory is partial below the top level.
delete_count_note: No path is marked DELETE. Nothing measured in this audit justified destruction over archival. The single REWRITE finding was resolved by wiring the orphaned validator into CI rather than by removing it.

paths.reason: Four reference applications exercised by the app-infra-ci workflow. Unrelated to the Golden model and independently useful.
The published guide. Individual pages are governed by the existing content gates, not by this audit.

Canonical operational slot procedure, including the sticky-setting command and its slotSetting read-back. It is the authoritative executable procedure; docs/operations/deployment/slots-and-swap.md carries the compact deployment-execution version and links to it.
Compact slot creation and promotion page. It links to the canonical operations page for the sticky-setting procedure instead of maintaining a divergent copy, and the two pages are linked both ways.
Generated dashboard. Its generator is not invoked by CI, so it can silently go stale; that is recorded against the generator rather than the output.
Generated dashboard, same staleness exposure as above.

Collector harness shared by several labs. Not a lab and not classified as one.
Run-scoped evidence and reproduction records. Evidence is never deleted without a separate review.
The Golden v1 contract surface: run manifest, assertion and result schemas. Deleting or moving these breaks every scenario that declares assertions against them.
The Golden v1 reference evaluator and independent-reproduction gate. Both are stdlib-only and are the only code permitted to derive a verdict from raw evidence.
The Golden v1 suites, including the negative cases that prove each gate discriminates. Removing them would leave the evaluator unverified while it still looked tested.
Single source of truth for content_validation scope. Its doctests run in CI.

Both are fixed at their source and the validator exits 0.
